}}'''Worms''' are a type of [[Mobs|Mob]], placed into the [[:Category:Deterrent Parasites|Deterrent]] Tier.
==''Spawning''==
*Summoned by [[Scent System|Scents]].
==''Behavior''==
Worms are a utility parasite entirely tied to the [[Scent System]]. Worms function similarly to [[Dispatcher Tentacle|Dispatcher Tentacles]], burrowing up from the ground before moving in mobs and then burrowing away, despawning.

*Worms will burrow up from any solid block.
*Worms will vomit a burst of several parasites into the air, set by the Scent that summoned them.

=== ''Weaknesses'' ===
*Worms, like any other [[Mobs|Mob]], present a weakness to Fire. Damage inflicted by Fire is quadrupled.
